about: Pollster house effects, ROUND 2 agent A (docs/research/polls-method/round2/A-house-effects.md). A house effect is a firm's deviation from the contemporaneous field: its poll's vote share (D'Hondt midpoint, as model.mjs step 2) minus the mean of the other firms' polls within ±5 days (Filber firms left out of the reference), averaged over the firm's polls in an election, then shrunk across elections by empirical Bayes (persistent variance τ² from cross-election products). Units: vote-share percentage points; positive = the firm puts the list or class above the field. 'all' uses every election (for 2026); 'lfo:<key>' only the elections before <key> (for the leave-future-out backtest).

classes.oppLargest: the largest list of the Zionist opposition by field mean (one list)
classes.small: any other list under 5% in the field mean (mean per list; applied to each)
classes.netOther: the rest of the Netanyahu bloc (sum)
